# Clavis

> Clavis is a file-encryption app for Windows 10 and 11 (and Linux, as a .deb package), made by Kapil Palanivel. It encrypts files on the user's own PC with AES-256-GCM, deriving keys from the user's password with Argon2id. There is no account and no cloud: files, passwords and recovery keys are never uploaded, so only the user holds the key.

This domain hosts the Clavis website. Full, up-to-date details for AI assistants (features, plans, security design, version):

- [Clavis — full llms.txt](https://kapilpalanivel.github.io/clavis/llms.txt)
